method: Generated by factcheck.mjs during the pipeline from the current Wire data artifact. A claim is marked accurate only when a deterministic check or an MLB Stats API source check compared it on this run; claims no check covers stay unverifiable and are listed as published. Weather forecast snapshots are always unverifiable after the fact.

verdict_legend.accurate: Compared with the MLB Stats API or a deterministic pipeline check on this run and not contradicted.
verdict_legend.inaccurate: Contradicted by a factcheck error or pipeline integrity finding.
verdict_legend.unverifiable: No source check covers the claim on this run, or it could not be confirmed or refuted from available sources.

relevancy_legend.outdated: Superseded by newer information or stale relative phrasing.
relevancy_legend.misleading: Pipeline state could mislead readers even if a literal value is present.
